name: o30134
description:
The Radius action **RadiusAction1** is currently enabled for both accounting and authentication, with each set to **ON**. It will retry the authentication server up to **3** times and will time out after **30** seconds if no response is received. The calling‑station identifier processing is **ENABLED**, and users will be placed in the default authentication group named **DefaultGroup**. Operational statistics show **5** failures and **120** successful authentications to date. The device’s own IP address is **192.168.1.100**, using attribute type **1** and vendor ID **1234** for IP handling. Password handling uses the **mschapv2** encoding, with password attribute type **2** and vendor ID **5678**. Radius attribute handling is configured with attribute type **3**, group separator “, ”, and a group prefix of **RG_**. The shared secret key for the Radius server is **secretKey123**, and the NAS identifier is **NAS12345**; the NAS IP processing is **ENABLED** and the vendor ID for Radius is **9**.

The remote Radius server is reachable at **10.0.0.5** and resolves to the hostname **radius.example.com**, listening on port **1812**. Tunnel endpoint client IP handling is **DISABLED**. All of these settings together define the complete configuration for the Radius action named **RadiusAction1**.
